sources.title: Iran MFA eVisa portal endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The endpoint is served from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs mfa.ir domain. On 22 August 2026 it responded HTTP 307 with Location set to the identical URL, preventing retrieval of current eligibility or issuance content.
sources.supportingExcerpt: HTTP 307 redirects this URL to itself during review.

sources.title: Iran MFA eVisa Traveller application endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The endpoint is served from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs mfa.ir domain. On 22 August 2026 it responded HTTP 307 with Location set to the identical URL, preventing retrieval of an application, nationality selector, or issuance terms.
sources.supportingExcerpt: HTTP 307 redirects this URL to itself during review.
